raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
A results-driven Backend Engineer with almost 7 years of experience, specializing in technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, Spring ORM, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, Spark, AWS (including EMR, ECS, S3, Lambda, IAM, EC2, MSK), Terraform, and PCF. Possesses strong expertise in the Telecom and Fintech industries.
raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Senior Consultant at Ernst & Young LLP (October 2021 – Present)
Designed, developed, and deployed multiple Java and Springboot based high-volume streaming data pipelines on AWS EMR using Apache Spark, integrating seamlessly with Apache Kafka for real-time data processing in production environments.
Designed, developed, and deployed RESTful APIs using Java and Springboot to enable seamless communication between microservices within an ECS cluster.
Developed an AWS Lambda function to generate end-of-day reports by extracting data from a PostgreSQL RDS database and transferring it to an S3 bucket in a cross-account setup. Additionally, authored Terraform code to automate the deployment and configuration of the Lambda function..
Contributed in developing a Kafka Consumer application and deploy it on AWS ECS with ALB.  Conducted a proof of concept (PoC) to implement SCRAM authentication on AWS MSK, enhancing secure access and authentication for Kafka clients.
Provided continuous maintenance and support for production services, ensuring high availability, optimal performance, and quick resolution of issues.
Experienced in system integration, including associated build and testing activities to ensure seamless functionality and reliability across integrated components.
Collaborated closely with business analysts and product owners to gain a deep understanding of core service requirements and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Actively participated in sprint planning as part of Agile project implementation, contributing to task prioritization, estimation, and ensuring alignment with project goals.
Provided ongoing mentorship to junior technical staff, fostering their professional development and enhancing their skills in various technologies and best practices.
Software Engineer at Tech Mahindra (May 2018 – October 2021)
Developed backend automated mapping to duplicate records for Data Requests which are used for testing applications with Springboot.
Contributed in writing stored procedures for retrieving records of data requests using PL/SQL.  Designed and developed a UI application to fetch reports of past data requests.  Debugged multiple applications and UI pages.
Programming Languages: Java, SQL, Typescript, Terraform - Frameworks: Spring, SpringBoot, JPA, Hibernate - Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL - Cloud Services: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, Codepipeline, EMR, IAM, Cloudwatch, VPC, MSK, SQS, ECS, ALB) - Version Control: Git, Github, Bitbucket - Tools: Maven, Jenkins, Postman, SQL Developer, PgAdmin
